# Event contract v1

Each JSON file is a synthetic, credential-free scenario. `version: 1`, `name`, `description`, and ordered `steps` are required. A step has exactly one of `event`, `reconnect`, or `expect`. Events use `seq`, `actor`, `type`, optional `transient` and `ts`, and a JSON object `data`; clients encode `data` as wire `dataJson`. A reconnect clears only transient tails, retaining durable state and cursor. Replayed durable events can overlap and must not duplicate facts.

`expect` is a partial map: only named facts are asserted at that point. `phase` is running/paused/idle/error/stopped; `awaiting_jobs` qualifies an idle phase whose session_idle carried `awaiting_jobs: true` (delegated work will resume the coordinator; present as active, not finished) until the next coordinator-side phase change — subagent activity never clears it; `pause_requested` is the durable pre-checkpoint pause flag; `cursor` is highest applied durable seq. `pending_question` is null or `{prompts:[...],options:[[...]]}` for a *human-actionable* gate only. `inputs` lists user_input `{seq,text,delivery}` (queued until a user_input_delivered referring to that seq). `answers` lists question_answered `{question_seq,provenance}`; auto:true means automatic, otherwise human (including another client's answer). `reviews` lists review_submitted `{seq,verdict}` with missing/unrecognized verdict normalized to unknown. `tails` maps actors to their latest transient turn_delta snapshot. Arrays are in event order.

Layouts, row folding, and review copy differ between clients. Harnesses extract these facts from real client reducers, not from expected values or an independent reducer. Do not weaken a fixture to accommodate a client: fix small projection bugs, or document a scenario+fact+reason+tracked follow-up in that harness. To extend the contract, add a synthetic scenario with intermediate expectations (especially before and after a reconnect), then update all three harness extractors when introducing a new fact. Increment `version` and update all readers if the schema changes. Transport replay is tested separately in the TUI and server packages. Run Go tests with `go test ./internal/tui ./internal/server`; run the web client harness with `npm test` in `clients/web` (Node from its `.nvmrc`); run Swift tests on a Mac with `swift test` in `clients/ios/YccKit` (not available on a Go-only host).
